title: How human is the machine? Evidence from 66,000 Conversations with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering classic judgment and decision-making scenarios (testing availability and representativeness heuristics, endowment effect, anchoring, transaction utility, and framing effect) to LLMs via API, prompting models to assume the role of research participants, and comparing the magnitude and direction of their responses against established human benchmarks and meta-analyses.
